reviews.x: I work out a lot and typically walk 16 miles a week. My feet always are dry and calloused. I LOVE these masks! My feet are baby soft now and ready for the beach.
It arrived today and used it today. I did not pregnant women cannot used this. I am 6 months pregnant. I dont have any reaction. I used the rose one it smell nice.
Bought for my mom and she said  they work well. After a couple of times mom got her soft feet back.

reviews.t: WOW. Buy this. Tik Tok Perfection.
reviews.x: Wowza these are awesome! Stuck the lavender ones on my feet, put three socks on, wrapped my feet in plastic bags and watched Jungle Cruise on Disney + while letting the foot magic do its thing. The peeling started the next day but was at max peel two days later. Baby soft feet! My callouses peeled off easily and I used hot water to get the excess peeling skin off. Worked like a charm. For really bad callouses you’ll need two peels for sure. Super happy with my purchase!!
Haven’t noticed any peeling yet because I only just did it like an hour ago but honestly my feet are so soft. I would buy these for the simple point of having baby soft feet. 100/10 would buy again.
This really works . For the price I was doubtful but it did a really good job. My feet were't as soft as the babyfeet brand . But good enough for the price I paid . Would definitely buy again .

reviews.t: So far so good I don’t have an allergic reaction to. , I will update once I begin peeling.
reviews.x: Since this is my very first time using this product I cannot tell yet until I had the results but so far so good I did not get an allergic reaction which is a huge win. As I am allergic to EVERYTHING and I do mean EVERYTHING,so I was hesitant to try this inexpensive item.I will update my review once I start feeling. I started with Aloe vera one first though.
These masks are helping to soften calluses, and get rid off a lot of dead skin that I have under my feet. They are priced very affordably for a product that works so well.

reviews.t: Soak your feet before using them.
reviews.x: First time I used it I just washed my feet. Tried one pack. A little peeling. Second time I used it I waited until my feet stopped peeling. But I also washed and soaked my feet for 20 minutes before putting them on. Watched a movie. Then few days later got super peely feet. Second time was the best honestly. Also while peeling soaking them helps them peel more. Also put socks on your feet while in the bags it works so much better than with out socks being on them.

These seem like they are decent quality for the price.  They aren’t foe large feet though.  I’m a size 13 wide and my feet don’t fit without cutting and my feet feel really squeezed.  If it works it will be worth it though
Exactly what I was hoping for!  The skin all peeled off my feet, so satisfying and love how soft my feet are now!!

Pleasant scent and tingling sensation while in use. Easy to use and clear instructions. Feet are starting to peel after a day and I’m looking forward to my results! Great value for only $6. Update: Day 3 feet are starting to peel significantly and skin in midsole where the skin peeled earlier is softer. My most callused area is my heel which is showing cracks/flakes but no big peeling yet.

I've used products like this before.  This one performed just as well as the more expensive ones for a fraction of the price.  My feet are rough enough to need at least two treatments, which gets expensive with the name brand products.  This product at this price was a great find!

Very easy to use! Took a few days for my feet to start peeling but after they did they felt very soft!  I let it on for 1 hour because my feet were very rough. Will use the 2nd application to keep the process up.
I love these! For years, I've been shy about my feet, but I just love these foot masks and I recommend them to all!!!!

This product is awesome. I have used one of the packets and it is so soft on my feet. Also it has help make my feet softer and also help minimize my calluses on my feet. This is a must buy and the price is awesome. Definitely will be buying again and again!
3 foot masks at this price is a great value. They definitely work as advertised and they smell great. Exfoliation started in 48 hours like stated on the packaging. Perfect for summer!

reviews.t: SOAK your feet before and after application.
reviews.x: This works, all you have to do it soak your feet in hot tolerable water till your feet are soft. Put the mask as directed( I did for 35 min). Next day just soak your feet again in hot tolerable water. I used Pumic stone, and the calluses just scrubs off. Mine didn’t peel like some pics in the reviews, but I soaked everyday for three days , twice a day. My feet are nice and soft.

reviews.t: They do what they say they will
reviews.x: It took 2 to make my feet sandal-ready,which is still way less than half the price of a pedicure.They come with 3 foot masks in rose,lavender and aloe.Nice packaging,clear English instructions,and a pretty potent product for the price!
Me and my husband is doing it and so far I love it it comes off very fast I will say soaking your feet does help a lot so what you waiting for go get it
This product was amazing! It left my feet feeling so soft and was so easy to use. I will definitely be purchasing this again!

Don’t mind my dirty feet in this pic, I was out by the pool. This stuff is wicked cool. Super easy to use, just cut open the booty, stick ur foot in, put some socks on, and relax for 1&1/2 hours. Try to cut as small a hole as u can manage to get ur foot into, and don’t lay down to relax or prop ur feet up cuz the liquid will come out the top. I started seeing slight peeling at 24 hours, but by 48 hours I had full-on peeling like in my pic, after I got out of the pool. THAT was satisfying lol! My

Very fast shipping. Product works great, I soaked my feet for about 20 min before use. I used the aloe one, I was watching tv and lost track of time, so they were on for about 90 min. I did put a pair of socks on after the booties.  Two days later I soaked my feet in warm water and the skin just started falling off.  I am excited to try the other two and I will definitely buy again. It has been 4 days since I used and my feet are still peeling, they are very soft where they already perled.

Works amazing! My whole foot is so soft again 🤌🏽 I recommend soaking your feet or showering until the bottom of your feet look like raisins.. then use the foot mask for the directed amount of time. Then soaking your feet or showering every day for a week. The peeling process is fun! I used one on my husbands feet his calluses were bad, he didn’t believe it would work… we both love the product!!! It’s amazing! I only needed one using the method mentioned above

Bought these for my mother and she loved them! She said the scent for the rose smelt amazing! The packaging had easy to follow instructions and so far amazing results so far as it’s a over time thing!

claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the masks leave their feet baby soft and effectively remove calluses and dead skin.
Many reviewers highlight the great value and affordable price compared to name brands.
Several reviewers note that peeling takes a few days to start and sometimes requires multiple treatments or soaking beforehand for best results.
Some reviewers mention the product is easy to use with clear instructions and a pleasant scent.
A few reviewers note the masks may not fit larger feet comfortably.

qa.q: Does it really peel off dead skin without hurting?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: How long does it take to see results?
qa.answer: Results vary: one reviewer saw feet start peeling after a few days [1], another saw skin falling off two days later [2], and another said it comes off very fast [3]. One reviewer noted they could not yet tell results since it was their first time using it [5].

claims.text: One reviewer said it took a few days for feet to start peeling.
Another reviewer said two days later the skin started falling off.
Another reviewer said it comes off very fast.
One reviewer could not yet tell results as it was their first time using it.

qa.q: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Does it smell strongly of lavender or chemicals?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it worth the price for three packs?
qa.answer: Yes, reviewers consider the three-pack a great value for the price [1][2][3][4]. One reviewer notes the masks don't fit large feet well, but says it will be worth it if it works [6].
